spans.s:
अर्ह् अर्ह्, cl. 1. P., ep. A. अर्हति, -ते,
आनर्ह, अर्हिष्यति, आर्हीत्, अर्हितुम्,
Ved. अर्हसे, to deserve, merit, be worthy; to have
a claim to anything, to be entitled to (with acc.);
to be allowed to do anything (with inf.); to be
obliged or required to do anything (with acc.); to be
worthy; to be worth; to counterbalance; to be able;
(the 2nd pers. pres. of अर्ह् with an infinitive is often
used as a softened form of imperative; e. g. दातुम्
अर्हसि, ‘be pleased to give;’ श्रोतुम् अर्हसि, ‘deign
to listen,’ for शृणु): Caus. अर्हयति (aor. आर्जिहत्),
-यितुम्, to honour: Desid. अर्जिहिषति [cf. Gr. ἄρχω].

अर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्, meriting, deserving, worthy of,
having a claim or being entitled to (with acc. or
inf.); being required, obliged, or allowed (with
inf.); becoming, proper, fit; worth (in money),
costing; (अस्), m. a N. of Indra; (आ), f. worship;
(आणि), Ved. n. pl. worship.

अर्हण, अम्, आ, n. f. worship, adoration, honour,
treating with veneration or respect; (आ), ind., Ved.
according to what is due; according to one's means.

अर्हत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, deserving, entitled to; able,
allowed to; worthy; venerable, respectable; praised,
celebrated; (अन्), m. a Buddha; the highest rank in
the Buddhist hierarchy; an Arhat or superior divinity
with the Jainas.
—अर्हत्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most
worthy, best, most venerable.

अर्हत्; after ‘a Buddha’ add — who is still a
candidate for निर्वाण.

अर्हन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, worthy; (अस्), m. a Buddha;
a Buddhist mendicant; N. of Śiva.
अर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, worshipped, saluted.
अर्ह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, worthy; respectable; right, fit.

अर्हरिष्वणि अर्हरि-ष्वणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
making enemies (अर्हरि) cry aloud; (if formed by
redupl. of हृष् with affix वनि) exultant.

आर्हत आर्हत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अर्हत्), belong-
ing to the doctrine of Jina or the Jains; (अस्), m. a
Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of Jina.

आर्हत्य, अम्, n. the quality or practice of an
Arhat or Jain saint.
